newsitem.title: UK: Schroders details tenders for Stakis shares.
newsitem.headline: Schroders details tenders for Stakis shares.

text.p: Schroders said on Thursday that it had received tenders for approximately 78.3 million Stakis shares representing 28.2 percent of the total issue for additional sub-underwriting at or lower than the standard rate.

It said that as a result, the aggregate primary and sub-underwriting commission expected to be paid by Stakis would be 4.2 million stg, a reduction of around 0.4 million stg or 8.4 percent from the usual level of rights issues for primary and sub-underwriting commissions.
Scottish-based hotels group Stakis made a four-for-seven rights issue at 86 pence per share aimed at raising 222 million stg to fund its 327 million stg buy of Lonrho Plc's five Metropole hotels.

In an innovative move, Schroders said it would save Stakis money on commissions by arranging a partial tender for sub-underwriting of the rights issue by investment institutions through which sub-underwriters would be able to tender at lower commissions for extra sub-underwriting above their initial allocations.
Schroders said it would then cut the primary underwriting commission charged to Stakis at the same rate as any reduction in total sub-underwriting chrages.
